Relevant test names (verbose reporter), all ✓:
- `Context header > Should set cookie headers when re-assigning Response to `c.res`` (updated; now expects all 3 cookies)
- `Context header > Should keep both existing and new Set-Cookie headers when re-assigning Response to `c.res`` (new regression test; asserts exactly 2)
- `Context header > Should keep previous cookies in response headers`
- `Context header > Should set set-cookie header values if c.res is already defined`

## Residual risk / edge cases

- **`c.res = c.res` (or assigning a response whose headers are also `this.#res`)**: `createResponseInstance` clones the existing cookies, then the post-loop append adds `existingCookies` again, duplicating them. The old code also duplicated cookies in this case (it appended all cookies once per `set-cookie` entry, i.e. N²), so this is not a new class of bug, but it remains. ## What changed

**`src/context.ts:414-433` — `set res`**
- The old code deleted the incoming Response's `set-cookie` headers and re-appended only the cookies from the previous `c.res`, so a handler's cookies were lost.
- The new code:
  - Captures the previous response's cookies once (`getSetCookie()`), then skips `set-cookie` while copying other headers, leaving the new Response's own cookies intact.
  - Appends the previous cookies afterward, so both sets survive with no duplicates. Node's `Headers.entries()` yields one entry per `set-cookie`, which is why the append happens once outside the loop.
  - Adds a same-object guard (`existingResponse !== _res`) so `c.res = c.res` cannot duplicate cookies.
- Cookie order matches the existing post-`next()` middleware path: `[handler…, middleware…]`, so behavior is consistent regardless of when middleware sets its cookie.

**`src/context.test.ts`**
- Corrected the pre-existing test at `src/context.test.ts:430` that encoded the buggy behavior (it expected the new response's cookie to be dropped) — it now expects all three cookies.
- Added regression test at `src/context.test.ts:449` modeling the reported case: middleware cookie on `c.res` + handler `Response` with its own `Set-Cookie`; asserts both survive and exactly 2 exist.
- Added guard test at `src/context.test.ts:464` for `c.res = c.res` (no duplication).
